title: Tryouts and Scholarship
author: Wendell Blackwood
blurb: Orsen Sandoval, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
